title: hedyotis chereevensis

This plant has been traditionally used in Thai medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
